args: [STAKR.space](https://stakr.space) is an independent professional multichain validator, securing blockchains since May 2020, serving community, providing public goods, having millions of dollars in staked assets and decentralized infrastructure validating Cosmoshub and chains, Solana, ETH, EigenLayer, Symbiotic, Hyperliquid, Monad, Fermah, Aztec, Interfold, Canton and others. We aim to grow the Gno.land ecosystem by providing MPP/x402-enabled RPC services, an explorer, useful tools, and user-facing services, including integrations with other blockchains.
